source.inventory: Every source-type identifier the stated SDK baseline hands back at runtime, read inside an iOS simulator on that baseline. Derived aggregation contracts are listed separately and are not platform source types.
source.rowScope: rows contains exactly the runtime source-type identifiers of the stated SDK baseline, one row per identifier, and derived mappings are excluded and declared separately; where Apple declares more than one constant for an identifier, every declaring name is listed in symbols.

evidence.scope: HealthKit data-type families and public source concepts
Runtime identifiers, their declaring constants, and canonical documentation pages
Exact SDK baseline, retained source terminology, and source-file hashes

sourceTypeCoding.rule: Every admitted HealthKit Observation preserves its exact sourceTypeIdentifier as an additional provider coding; the shared or authoritative standard coding remains the normative result meaning.

statusVocabulary.supported: The 0.3.0 HealthKit adapter defines and validates emitted FHIR output.
statusVocabulary.mapped-standard: The source is represented by another exact Grove or authoritative standard package rather than a Mobile measurement profile.
statusVocabulary.platform-exclusive: The 0.3.0 adapter defines output through a platform-exclusive HealthKit profile whose meaning remains HealthKit-specific.
statusVocabulary.unmodeled: The source type is inventoried, but no shared or HealthKit-scoped profile models it and no output is admitted.
statusVocabulary.deferred: No FHIR output for this source type is admitted by the 0.2.0 adapter.
statusVocabulary.intentionally-unsupported: The 0.3.0 contract explicitly rejects this source meaning rather than approximating it.

body-mass-index.reason: FHIR R4 already publishes an authoritative BMI profile; a one-source Grove Mobile wrapper would duplicate it.

the exact associated HKCategorySample objects when symptomsStatus is present

children.meaning: Exact HKCategorySample UUID under the HealthKit object NamingSystem
Exact admitted HealthKit symptom category identifier

sourceRevisionDisclosure.failureRule: Without explicit caller authorization to disclose every correlated symptom HKSourceRevision field, the structured HealthKit ECG output is not admitted and conversion fails closed.
sourceRevisionDisclosure.scope: Authorization is producer input and is not encoded as a FHIR consent or authorization assertion.

electrocardiogram.effectiveRule: Observation.effectivePeriod starts at HKElectrocardiogram.startDate plus the exact first timeSinceSampleStart and ends at the exact last supplied voltage instant. The required healthkit-ecg-source-period extension separately preserves the HKElectrocardiogram startDate/endDate.
electrocardiogram.admissionRule: The caller supplies already-obtained evidence. The supplied voltage count equals numberOfVoltageMeasurements; offsets are complete, unique, sorted, and satisfy offset[i] = offset[0] + i * SampledData.period exactly; every voltage is present; and samplingFrequency, when reported, equals 1000 / period in milliseconds exactly. Every associated symptom is supplied as its exact HKCategorySample UUID, start/end, type, severity, and complete HKSourceRevision fields. Symptom UUIDs are unique; distinct samples with the same symptom type remain distinct and are admitted. Missing, non-uniform, duplicate-UUID, resampled, or inconsistent evidence fails closed; the adapter performs no HealthKit query.

derivedAggregates.title: Sleep Duration Session Aggregate
derivedAggregates.requirement: This is not a HealthKit platform source identifier. Version 0.3.0 does not define the session-boundary aggregation contract; individual admitted samples map only to sleep stage.

rows.title: Apple Walking Steadiness Event
rows.requirement: Device alert: the enum encodes notification cadence (initial vs repeat) crossed with an Apple-defined banding of the appleWalkingSteadiness percent score, which is the actual measurement and is handled as a quantity type. The alert adds no measurement content beyond that score.

rows.title: Audio Exposure Event
rows.requirement: Device alert: a threshold-crossing notification against a user-configurable limit, not a measurement. The measurement is the environmentalAudioExposure dB(A) quantity type, which carries the actual exposure level.

rows.title: Headphone Audio Exposure Event
rows.requirement: Device alert over an OS-computed rolling seven-day dose limit; not a measurement. The headphoneAudioExposure quantity type carries the measured levels.

rows.title: High Heart Rate Event
rows.requirement: Device alert against a user-configurable threshold; not a measurement. Heart-rate quantities remain the measurement surface.

rows.title: Hypertension Event
rows.requirement: Device alert from a proprietary screening algorithm asserting possible pathology without any pressure measurement; emitting it as an Observation would fabricate a blood-pressure-adjacent finding with no quantity. Cuff blood-pressure quantities remain the measurement surface.

rows.title: Infrequent Menstrual Cycles
rows.requirement: Algorithmic screening alert over derived cycle history; not a measurement.

rows.title: Irregular Heart Rhythm Event
rows.requirement: FDA-cleared screening notification from a proprietary algorithm, valueless and read-only. Grove admits the ECG itself (sensor ECG adapter claim, HKDataTypeIdentifierElectrocardiogram) and the atrial-fibrillation burden percentage (HKQuantityTypeIdentifierAtrialFibrillationBurden) as the rhythm evidence surfaces; re-emitting the alert would present a screening trigger as a rhythm finding without any waveform or classification payload.

rows.title: Irregular Menstrual Cycles
rows.requirement: Algorithmic screening alert over derived cycle history; not a measurement.

rows.title: Low Cardio Fitness Event
rows.requirement: Device alert over an Apple-defined classification band of the VO2Max quantity, which is the measurement. Single enum case lowFitness carries no additional measurement meaning.

rows.title: Low Heart Rate Event
rows.requirement: Device alert against a user-configurable threshold; the heart-rate quantity series is the admitted measurement. An alert Observation would encode a preference-dependent trigger, not a physiologic result.

rows.title: Persistent Intermenstrual Bleeding
rows.requirement: Algorithmic screening alert derived from user-entered cycle data, not a measurement. The primary data (intermenstrualBleeding and menstrualFlow samples) is admitted through the cycle-tracking enum-absorption design; re-emitting HealthKit's derived possible-pathology flag would present a screening notification as a clinical finding.

rows.title: Prolonged Menstrual Periods
rows.requirement: Algorithmic screening alert over derived cycle history; the underlying menstrualFlow data is the measurement and is covered by the cycle-tracking design.

rows.title: Sleep Apnea Event
rows.requirement: Device alert, not a measurement: an Apple proprietary screening algorithm's notification of possible pathology. The underlying signal (HKQuantityTypeIdentifierAppleSleepingBreathingDisturbances) is the measurement surface; emitting the alert as an Observation would misrepresent a screening notification as a clinical finding.

rows.title: Activity Move Mode
rows.requirement: DECIDED: intentionally-unsupported. A ring-display preference has no semantically exact Mobile meaning; converting it would encode Apple product configuration as clinical data. Verifier attack (would a researcher want it?): the mode is only interpretive context for AppleMoveTime/ActiveEnergy rows, which carry their own units and are handled in their own rows; the mode adds no measurement content of its own. Reason survives.

rows.title: Biological Sex
rows.requirement: A HealthKit characteristic describes the subject rather than a measurement. Version 0.3.0 publishes no admitted output contract for characteristics.

rows.title: Date of Birth
rows.requirement: A HealthKit characteristic describes the subject rather than a measurement. Version 0.3.0 publishes no admitted output contract for characteristics.

rows.title: Fitzpatrick Skin Type
rows.requirement: DECIDED: intentionally-unsupported — applied as decided, not re-decided. Verifier correction to the stated reason: an exact LOINC does exist (66555-4), so the decision cannot rest on missing terminology; it rests solely on the decided scope call (single-platform self-reported phenotype outside the measurement contract, no consumer in the exchange set).

rows.title: ECG
rows.requirement: The caller supplies the HKElectrocardiogram, every voltage measurement with its exact timeSinceSampleStart, and each associated HKCategorySample when symptomsStatus is present. The adapter preserves symptom UUID/timing/type/severity and complete HKSourceRevision fields, classification, average heart rate, sampling frequency, reported count, Apple ECG algorithm-version metadata when present, source and waveform intervals, lead, offsets, and voltages without fetching or resampling. Explicit caller authorization for linkable symptom-source disclosure is required; otherwise conversion fails closed.
